load_img: load an image file from a given path and return a PIL Image object
show_image: display a PIL Image object using matplotlib's imshow
get_image_description: get a textual description of an image by converting it to its byte string representation
get_scene_graph_from_image: generate a scene graph with entities, relations, and attributes from an image using a VLM and parsers
review_image_utils: review the image utility functions for loading, displaying, describing, and generating scene graphs from images
